description: This file defines a GIFBuilder class used for creating optimized GIFs, especially tailored for Slack. It includes methods for adding frames, optimizing colors, deduplicating frames, and saving the GIF, with specific optimizations for Slack compatibility and emoji-scale GIFs.

classes.name: GIFBuilder
classes.description: A class for creating, optimizing, and saving animated GIFs with specific features for Slack compatibility and emoji size.

methods.name: __init__(self, width: int = 480, height: int = 480, fps: int = 15)
methods.description: Initializes the GIFBuilder with specified width, height, and fps, and prepares the frame list.

methods.name: add_frame(self, frame: np.ndarray | Image.Image)
methods.description: Adds a single frame to the GIF, accepting either a numpy array or a PIL Image, with resizing and conversion as needed.

methods.name: add_frames(self, frames: list[np.ndarray | Image.Image])
methods.description: Adds multiple frames at once to the GIF.

methods.name: list[np.ndarray] optimize_colors( self, num_colors: int = 128, use_global_palette: bool = True )
methods.description: Reduces the color palette of all frames using quantization, optionally creating a global palette for all frames.

methods.name: int deduplicate_frames(self, threshold: float = 0.9995)
methods.description: Removes nearly duplicate consecutive frames based on a similarity threshold.

methods.name: dict save( self, output_path: str | Path, num_colors: int = 128, optimize_for_emoji: bool = False, remove_duplicates: bool = False, )
methods.description: Saves the accumulated frames as an optimized GIF file, with options for emoji size, color reduction, and duplicate removal, and outputs file info.

methods.name: clear(self)
methods.description: Clears all stored frames to start fresh.
